name: Gladiatus Assistant
description: Persistent on-page Gladiatus character-profile capture with multi-character stats, roles, equipment and passive stat refresh, auction analyzer, passive expedition, Provinciarum Arena and Circus combat recorder, development-only Auto Expedition, Auto Arena and Auto Circus Provinciarum collectors with 5v5 opponent simulation and win-rate target selection plus configurable low-win-rate opponent-set safeguards, opponent target decision metrics, Circus combat-history aggregation and post-battle decision diagnostics, simplified Auto Combat dispatcher using global header cooldowns with configurable pre-click humanization delay and HP safety with automatic healing from a configured inventory page, DinoDevs-based LGPL-2.1 Arena and Circus Turma combat simulators, hypothetical equipment/stat simulation, and captured enemy profiles, plus master-diagnostic visible equipment capture tracing and additional native Arena/Circus simulation win-rate indicators that auto-analyze on entry and share one cached/in-flight result across native badges, manual analysis and Auto Battle, mode-aware simulator-driven stat-upgrade priority analysis, manual combat-stat adjustment analysis, and simulator-based auction equipment comparison, cached Gladiatus Fansite prefix and suffix auction filters, with resilient partial opponent analysis, transient automation recovery and Circus Provinciarum stale-action recovery. Enforces Arena/Circus opponent-refresh cooldowns before further refresh requests and counts a Circus Provinciarum fight as complete once a definitive Win/Loss result is detected and applies game-provided trainable-stat maximums to hypothetical equipment projections, native auction upgrade/downgrade indicators showing cached simulated win-rate changes.
